# DAST — Zaključna gradbena dela & Slikopleskarstvo

> DAST (ZAKLJUČNA GRADBENA DELA, DALIBOR STEFANOVIĆ, S.P.) is a Slovenian interior finishing and painting company specializing in Knauf drywall systems, Q1–Q4 wall skimming and plastering, machine airless painting, and moisture & mold remediation across western and central Slovenia.

## Business Identity
- **Brand Name**: DAST
- **Legal Entity**: ZAKLJUČNA GRADBENA DELA, DALIBOR STEFANOVIĆ, S.P.
- **Address**: Šmartno 35, 5211 Kojsko (Šmartno), Slovenia
- **Registration Number (Matična št.)**: 9919937000
- **Tax Number (Davčna št.)**: 27431673 (non-VAT registered)
- **Registry**: AJPES (Slovenian Business Register)
- **Website**: https://dast-finish.com
- **Email**: info@dast-finish.com
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +386 69 950 491
- **Working Hours**: Monday–Saturday, 07:00–19:00

## Core Services
- **Suhomontažna dela - Knauf**: Drywall partitions, suspended ceilings, linings, and Knauf finishing systems.
- **Glajenje in kitanje sten Q1-Q4**: Machine and manual wall skimming, plastering, corner beading, and dust-free sanding up to Q4 luxury mirror-smooth quality.
- **Strojno airless slikopleskarstvo**: High-pressure airless spray painting and manual painting using certified professional materials (JUB, Knauf, Caparol, Sto, Baumit).
- **Sanacija vlage in plesni**: Moisture and mold remediation, breathable anti-mold coatings, and full interior wall renovations.

## Service Areas (Slovenia)
- **Goriška & Nova Gorica**: Šmartno, Nova Gorica, Šempeter pri Gorici, Solkan, Ajdovščina
- **Primorska / Coast**: Koper, Izola, Piran, Sežana
- **Central Slovenia**: Ljubljana and surroundings

## Languages Supported
- Primary: Slovenian (`sl`)
- Additional: Serbian (`sr`), English (`en`), German (`de`), Italian (`it`)
